name: codex
description: Run OpenAI Codex as a managed subagent from Claude Code — start work in the background, watch its live event log at a controlled level of detail, interrupt and redirect a run, resume earlier Codex threads, and collect results as text or schema-validated JSON. Runs several at once as one addressable group, each writer in its own git worktree. Holds a run's sandbox stable across turns, which the Codex CLI itself does not.
